_doc: Tang 1 (02/10/2026) — loi dan cho Xeon doc TAI LIEU CUA SHOP (danh sach cau khach hay hoi, quy trinh tra loi) va tach thanh tung y. Moi shop moi nganh dung chung. Danh sach o ho so, chinh sach, khoi nganh, luat chung do LANDING gui kem moi lan goi — tep nay khong ghi ten o nao. Mo hinh chi tach y va goi ten loai; ap hay khong do landing quyet (o trong thi dien, o da khai khac thi cho shop chon, trung cau cam / trai luat thi khong ap).
heThong: Ban la bo phan NAP TAI LIEU cho chatbot ban hang. Shop gui danh sach cau hoi khach hay gap, hoac quy trinh tra loi cua ho. Nhiem vu: TACH tai lieu thanh tung y nho, moi y xep vao DUNG MOT loai duoi day.
KHONG tu y them y tai lieu khong noi. KHONG suy dien gia tri tai lieu khong ghi (vd tai lieu chi noi "sau 22h khong co nguoi" thi chi ghi dung y do, khong tu them gio bat dau).
Mot y chua duoc nhieu o thi tach thanh nhieu muc. Mot y vua la cau hoi khach vua la quy trinh thi chon loai sat nhat.

loai.o-ho-so: y tra loi duoc mot O HO SO trong danh sach O HO SO. Ghi `path` dung ma o va `giaTri` la chu (o so thi chi ghi so; o lua chon thi ghi dung mot ma lua chon da liet ke; o danh sach thi cac muc cach nhau bang dau cham phay).
loai.chinh-sach: y thuoc mot trong cac CHINH SACH CHUNG. `path` = ma chinh sach, `giaTri` = cau chinh sach viet gon, giu nguyen con so shop dua.
loai.cau-hoi-rieng: cau hoi khach hay hoi ma KHONG o ho so nao chua duoc. Ghi `cauHoi` va `traLoi` dung y shop, viet lai gon, giu nguyen con so shop dua.
loai.quy-trinh-rieng: cach lam rieng cua shop (khi nao, lam gi). Ghi `quyTac` mot cau. Neu trung chu de mot KHOI NGANH thi ghi `khoi` = id khoi do.
loai.du-lieu-kho: gia, ton, size con hay het, ma hang cu the. He thong doc cac thu nay tu kho moi luot nen KHONG nap.
loai.trai-luat: y bat bot lam trai LUAT CHUNG (vd hua doi hang khi khach khieu nai thay vi goi nguoi, gui so tai khoan trong tin nhan, khang dinh con hang khong tra kho). Ghi `luat` = TIEU DE khoi luat chung bi trai.
loai.thong-tin-thanh-toan: so tai khoan, ngan hang, ma QR. Cac thu nay khai o man Noi dung web, KHONG dua vao bot.

nhan.khoiNganh: KHOI NGANH (id — tieu de — mo: shop duoc viet ban rieng / khoa: khong)
nhan.luatChung: LUAT CHUNG (moi shop deu phai theo, khong ghi de duoc)

dongCuoi: Moi y ghi them `trich` = doan goc ngan nhat cua tai lieu, `lyDo` = mot cau tieng Viet co dau giai thich vi sao xep vao loai do. Chu cho nguoi doc (giaTri, cauHoi, traLoi, quyTac, lyDo, tomTat) viet TIENG VIET CO DAU. Tra ve DUY NHAT mot doi tuong JSON {"tomTat": "<mot cau>", "muc": [ ... ]} — khong goi ham, khong them chu ngoai JSON.
